name: fabric-toolkit
description: Microsoft Fabric data engineering. Medallion architecture and PySpark notebook skills with code templates, Fabric CLI reference, /fabric-deploy, notebook-reviewer and fabric-deployer subagents, safety hooks for destructive fab commands, the Fabric Core MCP server with Azure CLI auth, and userConfig for workspace settings.

workspace_name.title: Fabric workspace
workspace_name.description: Name of the Fabric workspace this project deploys to. Used by /fabric-deploy and shown at session start.

production_workspace.title: Production workspace
production_workspace.description: Name of the production workspace. The guard hook blocks destructive fab commands that target this workspace.
